title: Trump: US, PH may do ‘very big’ civilian nuclear project

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — United States President Donald Trump on Wednesday said Manila and Washington may do something “very big” related to civilian nuclear projects. Trump made the announcement during his bilateral meeting with President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. in the Malacañang Palace. “America’s civilian nuclear industry is also the best and most advanced in the world and we’re dealing with you on that,” Trump said. “For the Philippines to embrace American technology in its first modern nuclear project would underscore the strength of the important relationship and we’re gonna probably do something very big having to do with nuclear,” he also said.
